bugs.title: Education page opened on wrong default tab
bugs.description: Default tab was 'posing' (second item) while the tab bar renders 'timeline' first.
bugs.regression_test: Verify Education page opens with 'Prep Timeline' tab active and highlighted.
bugs.user_impact: User opens Education and sees the wrong tab content highlighted.

bugs.title: Workout timer continued after workout completion
bugs.description: Timer setInterval ran indefinitely even after phase === 'summary'.
bugs.regression_test: Complete a workout and verify the timer on the summary screen is frozen.
bugs.user_impact: Summary shows ever-increasing duration that doesn't match actual workout time.

bugs.title: Navigating away from active workout left no way to resume
bugs.description: activeWorkout remained in_progress in store but WorkoutSession overlay never remounted.
bugs.regression_test: Start workout, navigate to Diet page, navigate back — overlay must reappear.
bugs.user_impact: User is stuck mid-workout with no Resume or Cancel option visible.

bugs.title: Check-in form locked extra week after missed deadline (day-based schedule)
bugs.description: getNextCheckinDate started search from TODAY not last_date+7, so missing Monday meant locked until next Monday.
bugs.regression_test: Set schedule to Monday. Set last check-in date to 2 Mondays ago. Open app — form must be OPEN.
bugs.user_impact: User who misses check-in deadline is locked out for a full extra week.

bugs.title: Late check-in (submitted within interval window) falsely appeared as missed
bugs.description: probe < nextDate condition caused any check-in submitted even 1 day late to show as a 'missed Week N' panel alongside the real check-in.
bugs.regression_test: Submit week 2 check-in 3 days after expected date. Verify NO missed slot panel appears. The check-in panel must show only 'Week 2' without a 'Missed — Expected' entry.
bugs.user_impact: User sees 'Missed Week 2' AND 'Week 2 check-in' simultaneously — confusing duplication.

bugs.title: Missed slot labels used week_number conflicting with real check-ins
bugs.description: expectedWeek = sorted[i].week_number + 1 matched the actual next check-in's week_number.
bugs.regression_test: With week 1 on May 5 and week 2 on May 21 (interval=7), only 1 missed slot labeled by date should appear. No 'Week 2 (Missed)' — label must say 'Missed — Expected [date]'.
bugs.user_impact: User sees duplicate 'Week 2' labels — one real, one ghost.

bugs.title: logSet fire-and-forget: activeWorkout.sets never updated
bugs.description: logSet called window.api.logSet() but never updated activeWorkout.sets in store.
bugs.regression_test: Start a workout, log 3 sets, then navigate to a different component that reads activeWorkout.sets from the store directly — all 3 sets must be present.
bugs.user_impact: If UI re-renders from store state, logged sets vanish. Especially visible in WorkoutLogEditor.

bugs.title: mealCompletionHandlers returns {success:true} not the real DB record
bugs.description: Handler returned {success:true}. Store had to synthesise {id:Date.now()} as the meal completion record.
bugs.regression_test: Log a meal completion. Read mealCompletions from store. The entry's id must match a real DB id (positive integer). Logging the same meal twice should leave exactly 1 entry.
bugs.user_impact: Rapid double-tap on meal completion could create duplicate store entries with different synthetic ids.

bugs.title: nextAllowed/submit handlers used ORDER BY id DESC — broke after retroactive fill-in
bugs.description: After submitMissed, the inserted row has the highest id but an old check_in_date. ORDER BY id DESC picked this stale date, causing wrong lock computation.
bugs.regression_test: Fill in a missed slot for 2 weeks ago. Submit a new check-in for today. Verify lock screen shows 7 days (not 2 weeks + 7 days).
bugs.user_impact: After filling a missed slot, the next check-in date calculation is wrong.

bugs.title: computeWeeklyRate used week_number counter instead of actual date diff
bugs.description: weeksDiff was computed as newest.week_number - oldest.week_number. week_number is a sequential counter (1,2,3…) not an actual week count. For biweekly check-ins the rate was 2× too high; for daily check-ins 7× too high.
bugs.regression_test: Simulate 4 biweekly check-ins (14-day gaps). Weekly rate should equal weight change over 6 actual weeks / 6, not / 3.
bugs.user_impact: Progress page showed incorrect weekly weight change rate for any check-in schedule other than weekly.

bugs.title: Diet meal swaps lost on navigation (known - not yet fixed)
bugs.description: Originally swapping a meal updated only the Zustand store. The fix calls window.api.swapMeal(userId, mealIndex, alt) before reloading the plan, persisting the swap to the diet_plans table via plan:swapMeal IPC handler.
bugs.regression_test: Swap a meal in the Diet page. Navigate to Training. Navigate back to Diet. The swapped meal must still be shown.
bugs.user_impact: User spends time customising meals, navigates away, and loses all changes.
